description_en: Sends a message as input to the large language model (LLM)
kebab_example: aliyun ice send-ai-agent-text --instance-id f27f9b9be28642a88e180000 --text Hello. --region cn-hangzhou
name: SendAIAgentText

parameters.description_en:
The ID of the AI agent instance.

> InstanceId is a unique identifier that is returned when the AI agent is started. To start an AI agent, call [StartAIAgentInstance ](~~2846201~~)or [GenerateAIAgentCall](~~2846209~~).
